title: Pocketwire Rewards Quarterly Tier Review Rules
content:
Pocketwire Rewards tiers are reviewed on the first day of each calendar quarter against the qualifying spend of the previous quarter. The tier figures named here are each tier's entry threshold, retention spend and tolerated reviews below retention.

## Rules of the review

1. The qualifying spend of the previous quarter is purchase spend that earned points less refunded spend that was clawed back: the spend of earning entries dated in the previous calendar quarter less the spend of clawback entries dated in that quarter.
2. The membership moves up to the highest tier whose entry threshold that spend meets, and an upgrade is never limited in steps.
3. When the spend is below the current tier's retention spend, the count of consecutive reviews below retention goes up by one. The membership drops one tier only once that count exceeds the tier's tolerated reviews below retention, and the count then resets to 0.
4. A review at or above retention resets the count to 0 without a tier change.
5. Every review sets the next review date to the first day of the next quarter, and a change of tier sets the date the tier was assigned to the review date.
6. A tier is never changed between reviews, even at the member's request or on a goodwill basis.

## Hypothetical sequence

Hypothetical membership on a tier with a retention spend of 1200.00 USD and 1 tolerated review below retention, count at 0.

| Review | Previous-quarter qualifying spend | Count after the review | Tier change |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 January | 900.00 | 1 | none, because 1 does not exceed 1 |
| 1 April | 800.00 | 2, then reset to 0 | drops one tier, because 2 exceeds 1 |

A review at 1300.00 USD on the same tier, being at or above the retention spend, resets the count to 0 and changes nothing.

Upgrade example (hypothetical entry thresholds 500.00, 1500.00, 3000.00, 6000.00 and 12000.00 USD for ranks 2 to 6): a rank 2 membership with a previous-quarter qualifying spend of 6500.00 USD moves to rank 5, the highest tier whose threshold the spend meets, three steps up in one review.

## Points of judgement

- Qualifying spend is net: a 200.00 USD purchase that earned points and was later refunded with a clawback of the same 200.00 USD contributes nothing to the quarter's spend when both entries fall in that quarter.
- A request to move a tier on a date other than the first day of a quarter is not a tier change the rules allow.
